verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents workflows you can create, update, run, and delete via SDK or REST, plus job APIs to trigger runs and monitor status. That makes recurring execution achievable only by driving it from an external scheduler; no evidence shows a native schedule, cron, or recurring-trigger setting. Missing for 10: built-in workflow scheduling or cron configuration, documentation of recurring or interval runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
